methodology.prior_definition: Global prior is sqrt(review-count)-weighted; publisher means are partially pooled toward the global prior before recipe-level Bayesian shrinkage.
methodology.uncertainty_definition: Conservative score subtracts a capped 95%-style maximum-variance uncertainty penalty from the posterior mean.
methodology.evidence_definition: Schema.org AggregateRating is cross-checked against visible/microdata evidence when available; conflicts are quarantined from ranking.
methodology.dedupe_definition: High-threshold fuzzy clustering uses title, normalized ingredients, instructions, author, canonical URL, and image-URL fingerprint. Cross-site review counts are NOT summed.
methodology.history_definition: Every successful rating observation is written as an immutable per-run NDJSON record under data/observations/.
